answer.methodology: Prediction only; no assay outcome is claimed. For every candidate, score = ESM-2 masked-marginal ΔlnP + ln(2)×homolog-PSSM Δbits + ESM-IF1 total backbone-conditioned Δlog-likelihood versus the supplied wild-type sequence on chain A. Larger is predicted better. The MSA has 45 query-anchored rows; site-specific effective depth is reported in each selected basis when material.

selected.basis: Strongest three-channel agreement: ESM-2 ΔlnP +1.907, homolog PSSM +4.492 bits at depth 45, and ESM-IF1 backbone Δlog-likelihood +0.507. The conservative basic substitution leads the predicted ensemble.
selected.would_overturn: A broader nonredundant alignment that removes the strong Lys enrichment, or a multimer/DNA-aware relaxed structure showing an Arg-specific interaction with a penalty large enough to push its ensemble score below −2.800, would overturn this choice.

selected.basis: Evolution and backbone channels outweigh sequence-model dissent: PSSM +3.700 bits at depth 45 and ESM-IF1 +2.771, versus ESM-2 ΔlnP −1.584. Ranked second because two independent context channels strongly favor E.
selected.would_overturn: A deeper alignment that no longer favors Glu at site 18, or a relaxed electrostatic model showing that the added negative charge is strongly incompatible with the relevant assembly, would overturn it.

selected.basis: ESM-2 strongly prefers the small polar replacement (ΔlnP +1.206); PSSM (−1.000 bit, depth 45) and ESM-IF1 (−0.132) impose only mild penalties.
selected.would_overturn: A structure-relaxation result showing that Gly-specific backbone geometry is required, together with loss of the positive ESM-2 preference on an independently aligned sequence set, would overturn it.

selected.basis: Conservative acidic substitution with ESM-2 ΔlnP +0.460 and ESM-IF1 +0.625. PSSM is −1.585 bits but has effective depth only 4 at this gapped site, so it receives less qualitative confidence.
selected.would_overturn: This choice is sensitive to the shallow PSSM depth. A well-covered alignment at site 33 that strongly rejects Glu, or relaxed geometry showing a length-specific Asp contact, would overturn it.
